The factorization is left-looking by column. At step j the owner\n// of row j holds L[j][0..j-1] and the pivot value A[j][j] - sum_k L[j][k]^2 and\n// broadcasts them. Every rank then finishes column j for its own rows. The\n// broadcast of row j+1 is posted before the bulk of column j is updated, so the\n// communication overlaps with computation.\n//\n// Every element is computed with the same floating-point operations in the same\n// order as the sequential algorithm, so results are bit-identical for any number\n// of ranks.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowsFor(size_t n, size_t rank, size_t size) {\n    return n > rank ? (n - rank - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n}\n\nstruct Distribution {\n    size_t n;\n    size_t rank;\n    size_t size;\n\n    size_t localRows() const { return localRowsFor(n, rank, size); }\n    size_t owner(size_t i) const { return i % size; }\n    size_t localIndex(size_t i) const { return i / size; }   // valid on the owner of i\n    size_t globalRow(size_t m) const { return rank + m * size; }\n\n    // First local row whose global index is greater than i\n    size_t firstLocalRowAbove(size_t i) const {\n        return i < rank ? 0 : (i - rank) / size + 1;\n    }\n};\n\n// For local rows [m0, m1): L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n// `piv` holds row j of L. Four rows are interleaved so that independent dot products\n// hide floating-point latency. Each sum still accumulates in ascending k.\nvoid updateColumn(double* A, size_t n, size_t m0, size_t m1, size_t j, const double* piv) {\n    size_t m = m0;\n    for (; m + 4 <= m1; m += 4) {\n        double* r0 = A + m * n;\n        double* r1 = r0 + n;\n        double* r2 = r1 + n;\n        double* r3 = r2 + n;\n        double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            const double p = piv[k];\n            s0 += r0[k] * p;\n            s1 += r1[k] * p;\n            s2 += r2[k] * p;\n            s3 += r3[k] * p;\n        }\n        r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / piv[j];\n        r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / piv[j];\n        r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / piv[j];\n        r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / piv[j];\n    }\n    for (; m < m1; ++m) {\n        double* r = A + m * n;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum += r[k] * piv[k];\n        }\n        r[j] = (r[j] - sum) / piv[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Returns false if the matrix is not positive definite. The decision is identical on every rank.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<double> buf[2] = {std::vector<double>(n), std::vector<double>(n)};\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n\n    // The owner of row r copies L[r][0..r-1] and its pivot value into buf[r & 1] and\n    // broadcasts r + 1 values. Non-owners receive into the same buffer.\n    auto postRow = [&](size_t r) {\n        double* b = buf[r & 1].data();\n        if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(r) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + r, b);\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < r; ++k) {\n                sum += b[k] * b[k];\n            }\n            b[r] = row[r] - sum;\n        }\n        MPI_Ibcast(b, static_cast<int>(r + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(r)), comm, &req);\n    };\n\n    if (n > 0) {\n        postRow(0);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        double* piv = buf[j & 1].data();\n\n        // Matrix is not positive definite\n        if (piv[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (d.rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        piv[j] = sqrt(piv[j]);\n\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            row[j] = piv[j];\n            // Zero out upper triangular part\n            std::fill(row + j + 1, row + n, 0.0);\n        }\n\n        // The owner of row j+1 computes its column j first, so its broadcast can start early\n        if (j + 1 < n) {\n            const size_t r = j + 1;\n            if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n                const size_t m = d.localIndex(r);\n                updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, m, m + 1, j, piv);\n            }\n            postRow(r);\n        }\n\n        // All remaining local rows below j+1\n        updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, d.firstLocalRowAbove(j + 1), d.localRows(), j, piv);\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generates the same matrix as the sequential code: A = B * B^T, then add n to the\n// diagonal, where B is filled row-major from rand_r with seed 42. Every rank replays\n// the random stream but stores only its own rows. Only the lower triangle is\n// computed unless fullRows is set, since the decomposition never reads the upper part.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, bool fullRows) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    auto drawRow = [&seed, n](double* row) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            row[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Pass 1: keep the locally owned rows of B\n    std::vector<double> Bloc(rows * n);\n    std::vector<double> scratch(n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < n; ++r) {\n        drawRow(d.owner(r) == d.rank ? &Bloc[d.localIndex(r) * n] : scratch.data());\n    }\n\n    // Pass 2: stream all rows of B in blocks. Each local row is reused across a block.\n    Aloc.assign(rows * n, 0.0);\n    seed = 42;\n    constexpr size_t kBlock = 16;\n    std::vector<double> block(kBlock * n);\n    for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += kBlock) {\n        const size_t jn = std::min(kBlock, n - j0);\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n            drawRow(&block[jj * n]);\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = d.globalRow(m);\n            const double* bi = &Bloc[m * n];\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n                const size_t j = j0 + jj;\n                if (!fullRows && j > i) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double* bj = &block[jj * n];\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                Aloc[m * n + j] = sum;\n                if (i == j) {\n                    Aloc[m * n + j] += n;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Gathers the distributed matrix into a full row-major matrix on rank 0. Other ranks get an empty vector.\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<int> counts(d.size), displs(d.size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowsFor(n, r, d.size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(d.rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(Aloc.data(), static_cast<int>(Aloc.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (d.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowsFor(n, r, d.size);\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = r + m * d.size;\n            std::copy(packed.begin() + displs[r] + m * n, packed.begin() + displs[r] + (m + 1) * n,\n                      full.begin() + i * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\n// Validates L against the original matrix. Each row of L is broadcast in turn, and every rank\n// reconstructs its own rows of L * L^T. Returns the same verdict on every rank.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lloc, const std::vector<double>& Aorig_loc,\n                      const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> Lrow(n);\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Lloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lrow.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lrow.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(j)), comm);\n\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const double* li = &Lloc[m * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += li[k] * Lrow[k];\n            }\n\n            const size_t idx = m * n + j;\n            const double error = fabs(sum - Aorig_loc[idx]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(Aorig_loc[idx]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &relError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (d.rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    const Distribution d{n, static_cast<size_t>(rank), static_cast<size_t>(size)};\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix (local rows only)\n    std::vector<double> A;\n }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<double> L = gatherMatrix(A, d, comm);\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(L, The factorization is left-looking by column. At step j the owner\n// of row j holds L[j][0..j-1] and the pivot value A[j][j] - sum_k L[j][k]^2 and\n// broadcasts them. Every rank then finishes column j for its own rows. The\n// broadcast of row j+1 is posted before the bulk of column j is updated, so the\n// communication overlaps with computation.\n//\n// Every element is computed with the same floating-point operations in the same\n// order as the sequential algorithm, so results are bit-identical for any number\n// of ranks.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowsFor(size_t n, size_t rank, size_t size) {\n    return n > rank ? (n - rank - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n}\n\nstruct Distribution {\n    size_t n;\n    size_t rank;\n    size_t size;\n\n    size_t localRows() const { return localRowsFor(n, rank, size); }\n    size_t owner(size_t i) const { return i % size; }\n    size_t localIndex(size_t i) const { return i / size; }   // valid on the owner of i\n    size_t globalRow(size_t m) const { return rank + m * size; }\n\n    // First local row whose global index is greater than i\n    size_t firstLocalRowAbove(size_t i) const {\n        return i < rank ? 0 : (i - rank) / size + 1;\n    }\n};\n\n// For local rows [m0, m1): L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n// `piv` holds row j of L. Four rows are interleaved so that independent dot products\n// hide floating-point latency. Each sum still accumulates in ascending k.\nvoid updateColumn(double* A, size_t n, size_t m0, size_t m1, size_t j, const double* piv) {\n    size_t m = m0;\n    for (; m + 4 <= m1; m += 4) {\n        double* r0 = A + m * n;\n        double* r1 = r0 + n;\n        double* r2 = r1 + n;\n        double* r3 = r2 + n;\n        double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            const double p = piv[k];\n            s0 += r0[k] * p;\n            s1 += r1[k] * p;\n            s2 += r2[k] * p;\n            s3 += r3[k] * p;\n        }\n        r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / piv[j];\n        r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / piv[j];\n        r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / piv[j];\n        r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / piv[j];\n    }\n    for (; m < m1; ++m) {\n        double* r = A + m * n;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum += r[k] * piv[k];\n        }\n        r[j] = (r[j] - sum) / piv[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Returns false if the matrix is not positive definite. The decision is identical on every rank.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<double> buf[2] = {std::vector<double>(n), std::vector<double>(n)};\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n\n    // The owner of row r copies L[r][0..r-1] and its pivot value into buf[r & 1] and\n    // broadcasts r + 1 values. Non-owners receive into the same buffer.\n    auto postRow = [&](size_t r) {\n        double* b = buf[r & 1].data();\n        if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(r) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + r, b);\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < r; ++k) {\n                sum += b[k] * b[k];\n            }\n            b[r] = row[r] - sum;\n        }\n        MPI_Ibcast(b, static_cast<int>(r + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(r)), comm, &req);\n    };\n\n    if (n > 0) {\n        postRow(0);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        double* piv = buf[j & 1].data();\n\n        // Matrix is not positive definite\n        if (piv[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (d.rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        piv[j] = sqrt(piv[j]);\n\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            row[j] = piv[j];\n            // Zero out upper triangular part\n            std::fill(row + j + 1, row + n, 0.0);\n        }\n\n        // The owner of row j+1 computes its column j first, so its broadcast can start early\n        if (j + 1 < n) {\n            const size_t r = j + 1;\n            if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n                const size_t m = d.localIndex(r);\n                updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, m, m + 1, j, piv);\n            }\n            postRow(r);\n        }\n\n        // All remaining local rows below j+1\n        updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, d.firstLocalRowAbove(j + 1), d.localRows(), j, piv);\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generates the same matrix as the sequential code: A = B * B^T, then add n to the\n// diagonal, where B is filled row-major from rand_r with seed 42. Every rank replays\n// the random stream but stores only its own rows. Only the lower triangle is\n// computed unless fullRows is set, since the decomposition never reads the upper part.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, bool fullRows) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    auto drawRow = [&seed, n](double* row) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            row[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Pass 1: keep the locally owned rows of B\n    std::vector<double> Bloc(rows * n);\n    std::vector<double> scratch(n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < n; ++r) {\n        drawRow(d.owner(r) == d.rank ? &Bloc[d.localIndex(r) * n] : scratch.data());\n    }\n\n    // Pass 2: stream all rows of B in blocks. Each local row is reused across a block.\n    Aloc.assign(rows * n, 0.0);\n    seed = 42;\n    constexpr size_t kBlock = 16;\n    std::vector<double> block(kBlock * n);\n    for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += kBlock) {\n        const size_t jn = std::min(kBlock, n - j0);\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n            drawRow(&block[jj * n]);\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = d.globalRow(m);\n            const double* bi = &Bloc[m * n];\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n                const size_t j = j0 + jj;\n                if (!fullRows && j > i) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double* bj = &block[jj * n];\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                Aloc[m * n + j] = sum;\n                if (i == j) {\n                    Aloc[m * n + j] += n;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Gathers the distributed matrix into a full row-major matrix on rank 0. Other ranks get an empty vector.\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<int> counts(d.size), displs(d.size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowsFor(n, r, d.size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(d.rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(Aloc.data(), static_cast<int>(Aloc.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (d.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowsFor(n, r, d.size);\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = r + m * d.size;\n            std::copy(packed.begin() + displs[r] + m * n, packed.begin() + displs[r] + (m + 1) * n,\n                      full.begin() + i * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\n// Validates L against the original matrix. Each row of L is broadcast in turn, and every rank\n// reconstructs its own rows of L * L^T. Returns the same verdict on every rank.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lloc, const std::vector<double>& Aorig_loc,\n                      const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> Lrow(n);\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Lloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lrow.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lrow.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(j)), comm);\n\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const double* li = &Lloc[m * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += li[k] * Lrow[k];\n            }\n\n            const size_t idx = m * n + j;\n            const double error = fabs(sum - Aorig_loc[idx]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(Aorig_loc[idx]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &relError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (d.rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    const Distribution d{n, static_cast<size_t>(rank), static_cast<size_t>(size)};\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix (local rows only)\n    std::vector<double> A;\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, d, validate);\n\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, d, comm);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    // The slowest rank determines the time\n    double seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    auto duration = operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<double> L = gatherMatrix(A, d, comm);\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(L, A_orig, d, comm);\n\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", valid ? \"PASSED\" : \"FAILED\");\n        }\n        return valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\n} // \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n +    }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: The factorization is left-looking by column. At step j the owner\n// of row j holds L[j][0..j-1] and the pivot value A[j][j] - sum_k L[j][k]^2 and\n// broadcasts them. Every rank then finishes column j for its own rows. The\n// broadcast of row j+1 is posted before the bulk of column j is updated, so the\n// communication overlaps with computation.\n//\n// Every element is computed with the same floating-point operations in the same\n// order as the sequential algorithm, so results are bit-identical for any number\n// of ranks.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowsFor(size_t n, size_t rank, size_t size) {\n    return n > rank ? (n - rank - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n}\n\nstruct Distribution {\n    size_t n;\n    size_t rank;\n    size_t size;\n\n    size_t localRows() const { return localRowsFor(n, rank, size); }\n    size_t owner(size_t i) const { return i % size; }\n    size_t localIndex(size_t i) const { return i / size; }   // valid on the owner of i\n    size_t globalRow(size_t m) const { return rank + m * size; }\n\n    // First local row whose global index is greater than i\n    size_t firstLocalRowAbove(size_t i) const {\n        return i < rank ? 0 : (i - rank) / size + 1;\n    }\n};\n\n// For local rows [m0, m1): L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n// `piv` holds row j of L. Four rows are interleaved so that independent dot products\n// hide floating-point latency. Each sum still accumulates in ascending k.\nvoid updateColumn(double* A, size_t n, size_t m0, size_t m1, size_t j, const double* piv) {\n    size_t m = m0;\n    for (; m + 4 <= m1; m += 4) {\n        double* r0 = A + m * n;\n        double* r1 = r0 + n;\n        double* r2 = r1 + n;\n        double* r3 = r2 + n;\n        double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            const double p = piv[k];\n            s0 += r0[k] * p;\n            s1 += r1[k] * p;\n            s2 += r2[k] * p;\n            s3 += r3[k] * p;\n        }\n        r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / piv[j];\n        r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / piv[j];\n        r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / piv[j];\n        r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / piv[j];\n    }\n    for (; m < m1; ++m) {\n        double* r = A + m * n;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum += r[k] * piv[k];\n        }\n        r[j] = (r[j] - sum) / piv[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Returns false if the matrix is not positive definite. The decision is identical on every rank.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<double> buf[2] = {std::vector<double>(n), std::vector<double>(n)};\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n\n    // The owner of row r copies L[r][0..r-1] and its pivot value into buf[r & 1] and\n    // broadcasts r + 1 values. Non-owners receive into the same buffer.\n    auto postRow = [&](size_t r) {\n        double* b = buf[r & 1].data();\n        if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(r) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + r, b);\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < r; ++k) {\n                sum += b[k] * b[k];\n            }\n            b[r] = row[r] - sum;\n        }\n        MPI_Ibcast(b, static_cast<int>(r + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(r)), comm, &req);\n    };\n\n    if (n > 0) {\n        postRow(0);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        double* piv = buf[j & 1].data();\n\n        // Matrix is not positive definite\n        if (piv[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (d.rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        piv[j] = sqrt(piv[j]);\n\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            row[j] = piv[j];\n            // Zero out upper triangular part\n            std::fill(row + j + 1, row + n, 0.0);\n        }\n\n        // The owner of row j+1 computes its column j first, so its broadcast can start early\n        if (j + 1 < n) {\n            const size_t r = j + 1;\n            if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n                const size_t m = d.localIndex(r);\n                updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, m, m + 1, j, piv);\n            }\n            postRow(r);\n        }\n\n        // All remaining local rows below j+1\n        updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, d.firstLocalRowAbove(j + 1), d.localRows(), j, piv);\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generates the same matrix as the sequential code: A = B * B^T, then add n to the\n// diagonal, where B is filled row-major from rand_r with seed 42. Every rank replays\n// the random stream but stores only its own rows. Only the lower triangle is\n// computed unless fullRows is set, since the decomposition never reads the upper part.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, bool fullRows) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    auto drawRow = [&seed, n](double* row) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            row[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Pass 1: keep the locally owned rows of B\n    std::vector<double> Bloc(rows * n);\n    std::vector<double> scratch(n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < n; ++r) {\n        drawRow(d.owner(r) == d.rank ? &Bloc[d.localIndex(r) * n] : scratch.data());\n    }\n\n    // Pass 2: stream all rows of B in blocks. Each local row is reused across a block.\n    Aloc.assign(rows * n, 0.0);\n    seed = 42;\n    constexpr size_t kBlock = 16;\n    std::vector<double> block(kBlock * n);\n    for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += kBlock) {\n        const size_t jn = std::min(kBlock, n - j0);\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n            drawRow(&block[jj * n]);\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = d.globalRow(m);\n            const double* bi = &Bloc[m * n];\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n                const size_t j = j0 + jj;\n                if (!fullRows && j > i) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double* bj = &block[jj * n];\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                Aloc[m * n + j] = sum;\n                if (i == j) {\n                    Aloc[m * n + j] += n;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Gathers the distributed matrix into a full row-major matrix on rank 0. Other ranks get an empty vector.\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<int> counts(d.size), displs(d.size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowsFor(n, r, d.size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(d.rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(Aloc.data(), static_cast<int>(Aloc.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (d.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowsFor(n, r, d.size);\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = r + m * d.size;\n            std::copy(packed.begin() + displs[r] + m * n, packed.begin() + displs[r] + (m + 1) * n,\n                      full.begin() + i * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\n// Validates L against the original matrix. Each row of L is broadcast in turn, and every rank\n// reconstructs its own rows of L * L^T. Returns the same verdict on every rank.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lloc, const std::vector<double>& Aorig_loc,\n                      const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> Lrow(n);\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Lloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lrow.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lrow.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(j)), comm);\n\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const double* li = &Lloc[m * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += li[k] * Lrow[k];\n            }\n\n            const size_t idx = m * n + j;\n            const double error = fabs(sum - Aorig_loc[idx]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(Aorig_loc[idx]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &relError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (d.rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", }\n\n    const Distribution d{n, static_cast<size_t>(rank), static_cast<size_t>(size)};\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix (local rows only)\n    std::vector<double> A;\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, d, validate);\n\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky The factorization is left-looking by column. At step j the owner\n// of row j holds L[j][0..j-1] and the pivot value A[j][j] - sum_k L[j][k]^2 and\n// broadcasts them. The\n// broadcast of row j+1 is posted before the bulk of column j is updated, so the\n// communication overlaps with computation.\n//\n// Every element is computed with the same floating-point operations in the same\n// order as the sequential algorithm, so results are bit-identical for any number\n// of ranks.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowsFor(size_t n, size_t rank, size_t size) {\n    return n > rank ? (n - rank - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n}\n\nstruct Distribution {\n    size_t n;\n    size_t rank;\n    size_t size;\n\n    size_t localRows() const { return localRowsFor(n, rank, size); }\n    size_t owner(size_t i) const { return i % size; }\n    size_t localIndex(size_t i) const { return i / size; }   // valid on the owner of i\n    size_t globalRow(size_t m) const { return rank + m * size; }\n\n    // First local row whose global index is greater than i\n    size_t firstLocalRowAbove(size_t i) const {\n        return i < rank ? 0 : (i - rank) / size + 1;\n    }\n};\n\n// For local rows [m0, m1): L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n// `piv` holds row j of L. Four rows are interleaved so that independent dot products\n// hide floating-point latency. Each sum still accumulates in ascending k.\nvoid updateColumn(double* A, size_t n, size_t m0, size_t m1, size_t j, const double* piv) {\n    size_t m = m0;\n    for (; m + 4 <= m1; m += 4) {\n        double* r0 = A + m * n;\n        double* r1 = r0 + n;\n        double* r2 = r1 + n;\n        double* r3 = r2 + n;\n        double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            const double p = piv[k];\n            s0 += r0[k] * p;\n            s1 += r1[k] * p;\n            s2 += r2[k] * p;\n            s3 += r3[k] * p;\n        }\n        r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / piv[j];\n        r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / piv[j];\n        r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / piv[j];\n        r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / piv[j];\n    }\n    for (; m < m1; ++m) {\n        double* r = A + m * n;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum += r[k] * piv[k];\n        }\n        r[j] = (r[j] - sum) / piv[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Returns false if the matrix is not positive definite. The decision is identical on every rank.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<double> buf[2] = {std::vector<double>(n), std::vector<double>(n)};\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n\n    // The owner of row r copies L[r][0..r-1] and its pivot value into buf[r & 1] and\n    // broadcasts r + 1 values. Non-owners receive into the same buffer.\n    auto postRow = [&](size_t r) {\n        double* b = buf[r & 1].data();\n        if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(r) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + r, b);\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < r; ++k) {\n                sum += b[k] * b[k];\n            }\n            b[r] = row[r] - sum;\n        }\n        MPI_Ibcast(b, static_cast<int>(r + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(r)), comm, &req);\n    };\n\n    if (n > 0) {\n        postRow(0);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        double* piv = buf[j & 1].data();\n\n        // Matrix is not positive definite\n        if (piv[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (d.rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        piv[j] = sqrt(piv[j]);\n\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            row[j] = piv[j];\n            // Zero out upper triangular part\n            std::fill(row + j + 1, row + n, 0.0);\n        }\n\n        // The owner of row j+1 computes its column j first, so its broadcast can start early\n        if (j + 1 < n) {\n            const size_t r = j + 1;\n            if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n                const size_t m = d.localIndex(r);\n                updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, m, m + 1, j, piv);\n            }\n            postRow(r);\n        }\n\n        // All remaining local rows below j+1\n        updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, d.firstLocalRowAbove(j + 1), d.localRows(), j, piv);\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generates the same matrix as the sequential code: A = B * B^T, then add n to the\n// diagonal, where B is filled row-major from rand_r with seed 42. Only the lower triangle is\n// computed unless fullRows is set, since the decomposition never reads the upper part.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, bool fullRows) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    auto drawRow = [&seed, n](double* row) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            row[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Pass 1: keep the locally owned rows of B\n    std::vector<double> Bloc(rows * n);\n    std::vector<double> scratch(n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < n; ++r) {\n        drawRow(d.owner(r) == d.rank ? &Bloc[d.localIndex(r) * n] : scratch.data());\n    }\n\n    // Pass 2: stream all rows of B in blocks. Each local row is reused across a block.\n    Aloc.assign(rows * n, 0.0);\n    seed = 42;\n    constexpr size_t kBlock = 16;\n    std::vector<double> block(kBlock * n);\n    for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += kBlock) {\n        const size_t jn = std::min(kBlock, n - j0);\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n            drawRow(&block[jj * n]);\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = d.globalRow(m);\n            const double* bi = &Bloc[m * n];\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n                const size_t j = j0 + jj;\n                if (!fullRows && j > i) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double* bj = &block[jj * n];\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n                }\n                Aloc[m * n + j] = sum;\n                if (i == j) {\n                    Aloc[m * n + j] += n;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Gathers the distributed matrix into a full row-major matrix on rank 0. Other ranks get an empty vector.\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<int> counts(d.size), displs(d.size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowsFor(n, r, d.size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(d.rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(Aloc.data(), static_cast<int>(Aloc.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (d.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowsFor(n, r, d.size);\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = r + m * d.size;\n            std::copy(packed.begin() + displs[r] + m * n, packed.begin() + displs[r] + (m + 1) * n,\n                      full.begin() + i * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\n// Validates L against the original matrix. Each row of L is broadcast in turn, and every rank\n// reconstructs its own rows of L * L^T. Returns the same verdict on every rank.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lloc, const std::vector<double>& Aorig_loc,\n                      const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> Lrow(n);\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &relError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n Multiply-accumulates are written as std::fma and the build sets\n// -ffp-contract=off, so the compiler cannot fuse different operations depending on\n// how the loops are split.","originalFile":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed-memory Cholesky decomposition (MPI)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Rows are distributed cyclically: global row i lives on rank i % P, at local\n// index i / P. The factorization is left-looking by column. At step j the owner\n// of row j holds L[j][0..j-1] and the pivot value A[j][j] - sum_k L[j][k]^2 and\n// broadcasts them. Every rank then finishes column j for its own rows. The\n// broadcast of row j+1 is posted before the bulk of column j is updated, so the\n// communication overlaps with computation.\n//\n// Every element is computed with the same floating-point operations in the same\n// order as the sequential algorithm, so results are bit-identical for any number\n// of ranks.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowsFor(size_t n, size_t rank, size_t size) {\n    return n > rank ? (n - rank - 1) / size + 1 : 0;\n}\n\nstruct Distribution {\n    size_t n;\n    size_t rank;\n    size_t size;\n\n    size_t localRows() const { return localRowsFor(n, rank, size); }\n    size_t owner(size_t i) const { return i % size; }\n    size_t localIndex(size_t i) const { return i / size; }   // valid on the owner of i\n    size_t globalRow(size_t m) const { return rank + m * size; }\n\n    // First local row whose global index is greater than i\n    size_t firstLocalRowAbove(size_t i) const {\n        return i < rank ? 0 : (i - rank) / size + 1;\n    }\n};\n\n// For local rows [m0, m1): L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k] * L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n// `piv` holds row j of L. Four rows are interleaved so that independent dot products\n// hide floating-point latency. Each sum still accumulates in ascending k.\nvoid updateColumn(double* A, size_t n, size_t m0, size_t m1, size_t j, const double* piv) {\n    size_t m = m0;\n    for (; m + 4 <= m1; m += 4) {\n        double* r0 = A + m * n;\n        double* r1 = r0 + n;\n        double* r2 = r1 + n;\n        double* r3 = r2 + n;\n        double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            const double p = piv[k];\n            s0 = std::fma(r0[k], p, s0);\n            s1 = std::fma(r1[k], p, s1);\n            s2 = std::fma(r2[k], p, s2);\n            s3 = std::fma(r3[k], p, s3);\n        }\n        r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / piv[j];\n        r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / piv[j];\n        r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / piv[j];\n        r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / piv[j];\n    }\n    for (; m < m1; ++m) {\n        double* r = A + m * n;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum = std::fma(r[k], piv[k], sum);\n        }\n        r[j] = (r[j] - sum) / piv[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Returns false if the matrix is not positive definite. The decision is identical on every rank.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<double> buf[2] = {std::vector<double>(n), std::vector<double>(n)};\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n\n    // The owner of row r copies L[r][0..r-1] and its pivot value into buf[r & 1] and\n    // broadcasts r + 1 values. Non-owners receive into the same buffer.\n    auto postRow = [&](size_t r) {\n        double* b = buf[r & 1].data();\n        if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(r) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + r, b);\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < r; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(b[k], b[k], sum);\n            }\n            b[r] = row[r] - sum;\n        }\n        MPI_Ibcast(b, static_cast<int>(r + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(r)), comm, &req);\n    };\n\n    if (n > 0) {\n        postRow(0);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        double* piv = buf[j & 1].data();\n\n        // Matrix is not positive definite\n        if (piv[j] <= 0.0) {\n            if (d.rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        piv[j] = sqrt(piv[j]);\n\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            double* row = &Aloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            row[j] = piv[j];\n            // Zero out upper triangular part\n            std::fill(row + j + 1, row + n, 0.0);\n        }\n\n        // The owner of row j+1 computes its column j first, so its broadcast can start early\n        if (j + 1 < n) {\n            const size_t r = j + 1;\n            if (d.owner(r) == d.rank) {\n                const size_t m = d.localIndex(r);\n                updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, m, m + 1, j, piv);\n            }\n            postRow(r);\n        }\n\n        // All remaining local rows below j+1\n        updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, d.firstLocalRowAbove(j + 1), d.localRows(), j, piv);\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generates the same matrix as the sequential code: A = B * B^T, then add n to the\n// diagonal, where B is filled row-major from rand_r with seed 42. Every rank replays\n// the random stream but stores only its own rows. Only the lower triangle is\n// computed unless fullRows is set, since the decomposition never reads the upper part.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, bool fullRows) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    auto drawRow = [&seed, n](double* row) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            row[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Pass 1: keep the locally owned rows of B\n    std::vector<double> Bloc(rows * n);\n    std::vector<double> scratch(n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < n; ++r) {\n        drawRow(d.owner(r) == d.rank ? &Bloc[d.localIndex(r) * n] : scratch.data());\n    }\n\n    // Pass 2: stream all rows of B in blocks. Each local row is reused across a block.\n    Aloc.assign(rows * n, 0.0);\n    seed = 42;\n    constexpr size_t kBlock = 16;\n    std::vector<double> block(kBlock * n);\n    for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += kBlock) {\n        const size_t jn = std::min(kBlock, n - j0);\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n            drawRow(&block[jj * n]);\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = d.globalRow(m);\n            const double* bi = &Bloc[m * n];\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jn; ++jj) {\n                const size_t j = j0 + jj;\n                if (!fullRows && j > i) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double* bj = &block[jj * n];\n                double sum = 0.0;\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                    sum = std::fma(bi[k], bj[k], sum);\n                }\n                Aloc[m * n + j] = sum;\n                if (i == j) {\n                    Aloc[m * n + j] += n;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Gathers the distributed matrix into a full row-major matrix on rank 0. Other ranks get an empty vector.\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<int> counts(d.size), displs(d.size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowsFor(n, r, d.size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> packed(d.rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(Aloc.data(), static_cast<int>(Aloc.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    if (d.rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowsFor(n, r, d.size);\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const size_t i = r + m * d.size;\n            std::copy(packed.begin() + displs[r] + m * n, packed.begin() + displs[r] + (m + 1) * n,\n                      full.begin() + i * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\n// Validates L against the original matrix. Each row of L is broadcast in turn, and every rank\n// reconstructs its own rows of L * L^T. Returns the same verdict on every rank.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lloc, const std::vector<double>& Aorig_loc,\n                      const Distribution& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t rows = d.localRows();\n    std::vector<double> Lrow(n);\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        if (d.owner(j) == d.rank) {\n            const double* row = &Lloc[d.localIndex(j) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lrow.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lrow.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(d.owner(j)), comm);\n\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {\n            const double* li = &Lloc[m * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(li[k], Lrow[k], sum);\n            }\n\n            const size_t idx = m * n + j;\n            const double error = fabs(sum - Aorig_loc[idx]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(Aorig_loc[idx]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyKhPqjKFpxijqMCLv2j","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs on MPI. The timed decomposition is distributed across ranks and is about 2.7x faster than the original on a single rank and about 20x faster at 16 ranks (n=2048). Only `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `cholesky`, and no files were added.\n\n**Results vs. the original:** the MPI build is not bit-identical to the original binary. The original's last bits depend on GCC's FMA choices, which vary with vectorization. For n=31 the default original gives hash `ed8bfa75…` and the MPI build gives `84876fc6…`. The differences are in the last digits, and validation errors remain around 1e-13.\n\nWhat the MPI version does guarantee: it matches the sequential algorithm compiled with explicit `std::fma` at every multiply-add (bit for bit, including hashes, samples and validation output) for every rank count from 1 to 16 and n from 0 to 257. The error path matches too (same message, exit status 1, no hang).\n\n**Design choices:**\n- **Distribution:** rows are dealt cyclically across ranks. The factorization is left-looking by column. At each step the owner of the pivot row broadcasts it, and the next pivot's broadcast is posted before the bulk update so the two overlap.\n- **Rounding:** every multiply-add uses explicit `std::fma`, and the build adds `-ffp-contract=off`. Without this, results changed with the rank count. If you'd rather have strict IEEE arithmetic, switch to plain `a*b + c` with the same flag. That should match the original built with `-ffp-contract=off`. I haven't benchmarked the difference.\n- **Other parallel parts:** matrix generation and `-v` validation are also distributed, and `-r` gathers the matrix on rank 0 for the hash.\n- **Timing:** barrier, then the slowest rank's time, so the `Computation time` line now reports the slowest rank.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`, unconditionally.\n\n**Performance (default mode, no validation):**\n\n| n | original | MPI P=1 | P=2 | P=4 | P=8 | P=16 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 2048 | 2137 ms (1.34 GFLOPS) | 778 ms | 403 ms | 235 ms | 154 ms | 103 ms (27.8 GFLOPS) |\n\nAt n=1024, P=16 is slower than P=8 because each step's work is small."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":712,"cache_read_input_tokens":115294,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":712},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f2e878e5-1d09-4011-8ae2-01625756b2c8","uuid":"fa30efa6-d55b-45c6-b37d-80fbaea91844","timestamp":"2026-10-13T00:54:00.746Z","request_id":"req_011CfyKhPY83avtTZiCAMmkZ"}
